reactivation_steps: Open benchtwin/roversar.btw in BenchTwin HIL Studio.
Verify roversar-benchtwin.json power rails (VBAT_FUSED, V5_REG, V3_3) and netlist roversar.net.
Bind BenchTwin HIL pins to RoverHalProtocol in simulation/adapters/benchtwin/.
Set active_simulator to 'benchtwin' in deployment configuration.
